world.title: A meeting with Democrats over healthcare? Trump says he’s open to it
world.summary: President Donald Trump expressed openness to meeting with incoming Democratic senator Abdul El-Sayed to discuss Medicare for All, a national healthcare proposal. Despite this willingness, experts remain skeptical about Trump's support for the initiative. This comes shortly after Trump criticized El-Sayed during his campaign, highlighting a potential shift in dialogue regarding healthcare policy between the two parties.

world.title: Trump slaps new tariffs on 14 nations; India faces additional 17%
world.summary: The US Trade Representative announced new tariffs affecting 14 nations, including a proposed 17% additional tariff on Indian goods. This move aims to increase the duty burden on exports from these countries. The decision reflects ongoing trade tensions and seeks to protect American industries by imposing higher costs on imported products. The announcement was made on Wednesday.

world.title: Trump's newest order curtailing birthright citizenship is blocked by second judge
world.summary: A second US judge has blocked President Donald Trump's executive order that aimed to limit birthright citizenship eligibility. This ruling follows the US Supreme Court's rejection of Trump's earlier attempt to impose similar restrictions. The decision prevents the enforcement of the order, which was signed in response to the Supreme Court's previous ruling on the matter.

business.title: Rupee hits 8-month high, wipes out this year’s losses
business.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened by 72 paise, closing at 92.23 against the US dollar, after reaching an eight-month high of 92.19. This improvement enhances India's purchasing power and helps mitigate imported inflation. However, excessive appreciation may negatively impact export competitiveness and domestic manufacturing, raising concerns about the balance between currency strength and economic growth.

business.title: Mizuho and Avendus commence strategic partnership post KKR stake sale
business.summary: Mizuho Securities has formed a strategic partnership with Avendus following Mizuho's acquisition of a majority stake from KKR. Avendus will maintain its brand and identity, continuing to be led by founders Gaurav Deepak and Kaushal Aggarwal. This partnership aims to enhance Avendus's capabilities and offerings while leveraging Mizuho's resources and expertise in the financial sector.

business.title: Gold crash triggers auction notices as LTV breaches hit lenders
business.summary: Gold finance companies are issuing legal auction notices as loan-to-value limits are breached due to falling gold prices. A significant decline in prices has led to nearly 40% of gold-loan portfolios exceeding permissible ratios. Lenders are urging borrowers to provide additional collateral or make partial payments to prevent auctions, highlighting the impact of the current market conditions.

technology.title: GTA VI redefines gameplay with progressive themes
technology.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI, released 13 years after its predecessor, has generated $3.8 billion in retail sales on its first day. The game introduces a mandatory female co-protagonist and explores relationship dynamics, prompting discussions among gamers. This installment aims to redefine gameplay with progressive themes, reflecting evolving societal norms while maintaining the franchise's signature style and engagement.

technology.title: GTA 6 Feels Entirely Different on PS5 Pro Thanks to 1 Feature
technology.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI, after a 13-year wait, offers distinct visual experiences on different platforms. A PS5 Pro-exclusive feature enhances graphics, setting it apart from other consoles. Players can explore the Florida-inspired locale with characters Leonida, Jason Duval, and Lucia Caminos. The game's release has generated significant interest, highlighting the advancements in gaming technology and design.

technology.title: GTA 6 game dump runs on PS5 console jailbreak, boosting piracy and PC emulator
technology.summary: Footage of GTA 6 running on a PS5 console jailbreak has emerged, alongside a 540 GB game dump that includes a decrypted eboot.bin. The retail version requires PS5 firmware 14.23, but it reportedly operates on version 11.60. This development is attracting interest from homebrew enthusiasts and piracy groups, as Take-Two focuses on Xbox-based PC ports.

sports.title: Mr. Champions League strikes again: Anthony Gordon leads Barçelona’s rotated side past Sabah
sports.summary: Anthony Gordon scored for Barcelona in their Champions League match against Sabah, leading the rotated side to victory. The England forward now has 13 goals in 23 Champions League appearances. Despite not being the most creative player, Gordon's contributions were crucial for coach Hansi Flick. Barcelona's win was expected, reflecting their strong performance in the tournament.

sports.title: Man United's errors overshadow progress under Pochettino
sports.summary: Manchester United displayed signs of improvement under head coach Mauricio Pochettino but suffered a setback with a loss to Sporting CP in the Champions League due to recurring mistakes. Pochettino, in his early days at the club, faces challenges as familiar issues resurface. The team's performance raises concerns ahead of their upcoming match against Liverpool.

sports.title: Awards from Bayern Munich’s 2-1 Champions League loss to LOSC Lille
sports.summary: Bayern Munich lost 2-1 to LOSC Lille in the UEFA Champions League, marking their first defeat of the 2026/27 season. Due to attacking shortages, manager Vincent Kompany adopted a defensive strategy reminiscent of Sir Alex Ferguson's 2011 Manchester United team. The match highlighted Bayern's struggles in attack, leading to a disappointing performance and unexpected loss in the tournament.

health.title: Your risk of heart attack and stroke could be forecasted 30 years in advance, study suggests
health.summary: A new study indicates that measuring cholesterol, blood pressure, and certain blood proteins early in life could predict heart attack and stroke risk up to 30 years in advance. Researchers emphasize the importance of assessing these factors sooner, as they are critical for estimating cardiovascular disease risk. This approach may enhance early intervention strategies for better health outcomes.

health.title: Newer glioblastoma drugs fail to improve survival, analysis says
health.summary: An analysis of over 20 newer glioblastoma drugs, including immunotherapies and targeted therapies, revealed that none improved survival rates compared to the established standard of care, which includes surgery, radiation, and chemotherapy. This finding highlights the ongoing challenges in treating glioblastoma effectively, as researchers continue to seek more effective treatment options for this aggressive brain cancer.

health.title: Aakash Desai: Local Consolidative Therapy in the Immunotherapy Era of NSCLC
health.summary: Aakash Desai, an Associate Professor at UAB O’Neal Cancer Center, discussed the role of local consolidative therapy in treating non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) during the immunotherapy era. He referenced the NRG-LU002 randomized phase II trial published in the Journal of Clinical Oncology, which indicates that local therapy for remaining metastases is not routinely recommended when first-line immunotherapy is effective.

science.title: Digital attack to deceive depth estimation models in autonomous vehicle systems using imperceptible adversarial perturbation
science.summary: This study presents a method for creating digital adversarial attacks on depth estimation models used in autonomous vehicles. By utilizing Diffusion Models and Grad-CAM maps, researchers generated perturbations that mislead models into inaccurate depth predictions. Evaluations indicated the approach effectively disrupted predictions while maintaining visual fidelity, highlighting potential vulnerabilities in computer vision systems in real-world applications.

science.title: BepiColombo Reaches Mercury Orbit After Eight-Year Journey
science.summary: BepiColombo, a joint mission by the European Space Agency and Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency, successfully entered Mercury's orbit on November 21, 2026, after an eight-year journey. The mission aims to deploy two science probes to investigate Mercury's surface, interior, and magnetic field. This marks only the second time a spacecraft has orbited Mercury, following NASA's MESSENGER mission.

science.title: Hera Probe Reveals DART Blast Reshaped Asteroid Dimorphos With Stadium
science.summary: The European Space Agency's Hera probe has provided the first detailed observations of the asteroid Dimorphos since NASA's DART spacecraft impacted it in 2022. Findings indicate that the asteroid was not only cratered but also flattened and displaced, reshaping its structure significantly. These insights enhance understanding of the effects of asteroid impacts and the dynamics of such celestial bodies.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Today: November 26, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 26, 2026, horoscopes suggest a night of relaxation and enjoyment, particularly for Libra. The stars encourage individuals to unwind, play music, and dance with friends. It emphasizes the importance of taking breaks and savoring good moments in life. The message is clear: embrace joy and connection, allowing oneself to celebrate and recharge amidst daily routines.

entertainment.title: Sagittarius Horoscope Today: November 26, 2026
entertainment.summary: Sagittarius individuals are encouraged to embrace structure as a means to enhance their freedom rather than restrict it. The horoscope suggests that establishing a solid foundation can facilitate personal growth and future expansion. By recognizing the benefits of structure, Sagittarians can shape their lives in a way that balances their adventurous spirit with stability and support.

entertainment.title: Aries Horoscope Today: November 26, 2026
entertainment.summary: On November 26, 2026, Aries individuals are encouraged to find common ground in their ideas and focus on one to develop further. The horoscope highlights the importance of close friendships and community ties, suggesting that despite feelings of loneliness, there is a supportive network available. Emphasis is placed on collaboration and nurturing connections for personal growth.
